name: flac3d-grid
description: The block model as a FLAC3D grid — one hexahedral zone per mine block, gridpoints at the block corners. This is the handover point to a coupled mechanical model.

layout.default_filename: `.f3grid` is appended to the name given

notes: The engine confirms with `--- The BlockModel has been exported to <name>.f3grid`.
Unlike `export-caved`, the extension is added for you.
official_documentation: Not in the manual — the command has no page. Read back from the file it writes.
